title: AI provider catalogue
$comment: S1-11 (blueprint §1.1, §12.3 screen 5; ADR-004 D1/D6). The one list of AI providers the product knows about, shared by the Laravel core (App\AI\Providers\SupportedProviders) and the Mac installer (AiProviderCatalog); both mirror it statically and a test on each side pins the equality. `adapter_available` is the only field that changes over time: it flips to true in the PR that lands a bound App\AI\Providers\AiProviderAdapter for the provider (tests/Unit/AI/SupportedProvidersTest.php refuses a flag without a binding and a binding without the flag). SELECT_AI and the PWA list only entries with adapter_available true (§1.1 "only options a real adapter supports"); nothing in this file is ever preselected. See docs/architecture/ai-state.md.

id.description: Stable provider id: the value of LEA_AI_PROVIDER, the Swift AiProviderID / LocalAiRuntime id and the key under lang/*/ai.php `providers`.

kind.description: local runs on the owner's Mac (no key, no egress); remote is the owner's own account with a key stored by the Supervisor (ADR-003).

driver.description: Laravel AI SDK driver the adapter is built on (ADR-004 D1 table).

adapter_available.description: True only when a real AiProviderAdapter implementation for this provider is bound in the core.
